conventions.direction: Delta L = first minus second (pp of the ideal objective); score = share of seed pairs won by the first method, ties 1/2
conventions.objective_tie_units: benchmark objective (15 x expected farm power in kW)

violation.definition: V = sum_i max(0, x_i^2+y_i^2-r^2)/r^2 + sum_{i<j} max(0, l_min-l_ij)/l_min, l_min = 308 m

ci_levels.case: cases resampled (cluster bootstrap; all seeds of a case together)
ci_levels.two_stage: cases resampled, then the 30 seeds within each resampled case
ci_levels.seed: cases fixed, seeds resampled within cases (JSON only)

B3.convention: H0-: Delta <= -m is rejected iff the share k-/B of bootstrap means <= -m satisfies (k- + 1)/(B + 1) <= 0.05; H0+: Delta >= m likewise with means >= +m; ties at the margin count against equivalence; p_TOST = max; the CI rule requires -m < q_0.05 and q_0.95 < m (numpy linear interpolation). With B = 10,000, p <= 0.05 iff k <= 499, which implies the CI rule; the two can differ only if exactly k = 500 (then p = 0.0501 but q_0.05 interpolates between the 500th and 501st order statistics).

initial_population_replay.note: the wind data set does not enter init_pop; the drivers (mpce_experiments.run_grid, full_grid_experiments) seed the global MT19937 stream with the run's seed (np.random.seed) in the optimizer constructor and draw the initial population first, so seed k gives the same uniform draws in every case
